limitations: Synthetic XYZRHW vertices already in screen space: no camera or model/view/projection transforms were replayed.
Only one flat opaque untextured triangle was tested; no depth test, index buffers, vertex buffers, shader programs, lighting or materials were replayed.
The validator requires explicit synthetic-fixture attestation and cannot rule out unobserved D3D8 operations in arbitrary captures.
Exact parity is a result for this fixture and runtime, not a guarantee across hardware or for other D3D8 rendering.
No TDS frame, gameplay or stealth behavior, native Windows GPU, swapchain presentation, or GPU timings were validated.
